name: contract-game-generated-types
goal: Compile generated 2d and 3d game projects through source and bundled CLI entrypoints using their unchanged standard cases

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The existing four dimension/entry cases fail normal game checks because generated inventory routes cannot resolve $app/state. Failed diagnostic capture a815fa4a120a retains full compiler output; actual game rendering still passes before compilation.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing app CLI case also generates an API whose SvelteKit import masks missing ambient declarations. Preserve the four game combinations; strengthen the existing app-plan case with a framework type-reference assertion and retain normal compiler execution.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At test-only f37f77d370, laptop red e16f1da1a990 fails the existing standalone app type-reference case and four existing game combinations. Compiler output identifies unresolved $app/state before screenshot baseline admission.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Product-only a1dd559fbc emits src/app.d.ts with the framework ambient type reference for every generated app/game. Standalone routes resolve virtual modules without incidental API imports; frozen cases are unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Matched laptop green 3d6924ccbe4a passes the identical ten-case command after red e16f1da1a990. All four game combinations compile, reject missing baselines, build, audit and retain gameplay/invalid-document assertions.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
